ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, given the linear function $y=kx+b(k\ne 0)$ whose graph is illustrated, what is the solution set of the inequality $kx+b>0$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} When $x<1$, we have $y>0$,\\
thus the solution set for the inequality $kx+b>0$ is $x<1$.\\
Therefore, the answer is $\boxed{x<1}$.
